. When the informant's son and electrician, Md. Sabbir came there, they were also assaulted by them.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
It is submitted that the alleged occurrence took place on 06.03.2024 and the F.I.R. has been lodged on 19.04.2024 after a delay of 44 days for which no explanation has been given by the prosecution.
There is general and omnibus allegation against the petitioner.
There is no injury report of the injured on the record and they denied to be medically examined by the doctor.
The other co-accused persons have already been granted bail by this court vide order dated 20.11.2024 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 64085/2024.
The petitioner has one criminal antecedent as stated in para 3 of the bail petition.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.69586 of 2024(2) dt.11-12-2024 of the case, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court concerned, West, Muzaffarpur in connection with Paroo (Paru) P.S. Case No. 104 of 2024, subject to conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
7. The application stands allowed.

(Chandra Prakash Singh, J) atul/-
